Hey there. As you probably know, you can only post the same URL in a subverse once per sub before the repost filter catches you. I mod for a community and sometimes we'll get a post that breaks our post title rule and is perfectly fine to repost with a clear title. Often in those cases I'll suggest reposting with a clearer title, but the poster is unable to repost because it's caught in the repost filter. I want to propose allowing reposting of a removed post because it would allow users to make minor corrections without tripping the filter and because it's not really a repost if the existing post has been removed.

The downside is that spammers would be able to post twice if we remove a link, but spammers usually incur a ban anyway for multiple offenses.
Stop a removed post from counting against your link repost limit

I also think it is worth considering clearing the repost limit after a certain amount of time has past. I don't think there is anything wrong with reposting content that would be relevant to new users if enough time has past
